system.description: A Focus for enduring hardship and returning to the fight.

abilities.name: Determination
abilities.description: Gain a free Effort level when retrying a failed task until your next recovery.

abilities.name: Push on Through
abilities.description: Replace a ten-minute recovery with a second one-action recovery and endure one extra moderate wound.

abilities.name: Safe Fall
abilities.description: Ignore one wound caused by a fall.

abilities.name: Always Mighty
abilities.description: Restore one extra Might point whenever a recovery restores Might, up to three selections.

abilities.name: Ignore the Pain
abilities.description: Ignore one step of wound hindrance, with additional selections ignoring more.

abilities.name: Hidden Reserves
abilities.description: A one-action recovery grants +1 Might Edge and Speed Edge until a longer recovery.

abilities.name: Blood Fever
abilities.description: When depleted or badly wounded, gain an asset on attacks or defense and intimidation.

abilities.name: Outlast the Foe
abilities.description: After five full combat rounds, gain an asset on all tasks and deal 1 extra damage per attack.

abilities.name: Increasing Determination
abilities.description: A failed noncombat physical task becomes easier when retried once.

abilities.name: Not Dead Yet
abilities.description: Survive a normally fatal blow, wake after a round, restore Pools, and remove wounds.

abilities.name: Final Defiance
abilities.description: Remain conscious for another round after death and struggle to stay alive.

abilities.name: Ignore Affliction
abilities.description: Ignore an unwanted condition or affliction until a one-hour recovery.
